## Preliminaries

We load R libraries, and an R function to compute MFPCA projection scores.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source("00_init.R")
source("02_projection_scores.R")

#knee kinematic data for individuals with PD 
PD_data <- readRDS("Datasets/left_knee_data.RDS")

#data on gold-standard outcomes for individuals with PD 
PDGinfo <- read_excel("Datasets/PDGinfo.xlsx")

#knee kinematic data for healthy participants
healthy_data <- readRDS("Datasets/Fukuchi_left_knee.RDS")
healthy_data <- healthy_data %>% filter(`Gait cycle [%]`!=0)
```

## Datasets

We use left knee flexion-extension data from two open source datasets.

### Parkinson's Disease

The first dataset is from individuals living with Parkinson's Disease. This is obtained from:

Daniel Boari (2021). A dataset of overground walking full-body kinematics and kinetics in individuals with Parkinson’s disease. figshare. Dataset. <https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.14896881.v4>

### Healthy Dataset

The second dataset is from healthy individuals. This is obtained from:

Claudiane Fukuchi, Reginaldo Fukuchi, and Marcos Duarte. A public data set of overground and treadmill walking kinematics and kinetics of healthy individuals, 2018. URL <https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/A_public_data_set_of_overground_and_treadmill_walking_kinematics_and_kinetics_of_healthy_individuals/5722711>[\
](This is obtained from: #Claudiane Fukuchi, Reginaldo Fukuchi, and Marcos Duarte. A public data set of overground and #treadmill walking kinematics and kinetics of healthy individuals, 2018. URL https://doi.org/ # 10.6084/m9.figshare.5722711.v6. #https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/A_public_data_set_of_overground_and_treadmill_walking_kinematics_and_kinetics_of_healthy_individuals/5722711)\
Please see "01_combine_datasets.R" to see how left knee flexion-extension data is extracted from the datasets.

The PD dataset is shown below. Four subjects do not have UPDRS scores recorded, so they are excluded from this analysis.

```{r}
PD_data <- PD_data %>% 
  filter(!(Subject %in% c("SUB04", "SUB23", "SUB25", "SUB26")))

head(PD_data)
```

In addition to kinematic data, we have data on clinical outcomes, which are tidied below.

```{r}
PDGinfo <- PDGinfo %>% 
  filter(!(ID %in% c("SUB04", "SUB23", "SUB25", "SUB26")))

head(PDGinfo)

diagnosis_wide <- data.frame(Subject=PDGinfo$ID, 
                             UPDRS_II_OFF= PDGinfo$`OFF - UPDRS-II`,
                             UPDRS_III_OFF= PDGinfo$`OFF - UPDRS-III`,
                             UPDRS_II_ON=PDGinfo$`ON - UPDRS-II`,
                             UPDRS_III_ON=PDGinfo$`ON - UPDRS-III`) 
```

# Visualising knee flexion-extention curves

We visualise the kinematic data, focusing on on just four patients. We illustrate the knee flexion-extension curves over the Gait cycle on two occasions per person: when they are on medication, versus when they are off medication.

```{r}

plot_data <- PD_data %>% filter(Subject %in% c("SUB01", "SUB02", "SUB03", "SUB07"))

plot_data$Subject <- factor(plot_data$Subject)
levels(plot_data$Subject) =c("Subject 01", "Subject 02", "Subject 03", "Subject 07")

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x=`Gait cycle [%]`, y=value, group=Stride)) +
  geom_line(color="grey30") + 
  theme_bw()+
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # 0 makes text horizontal
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))+
  facet_grid(Medication~Subject) + 
  ylab("Knee flexion-extension angle")

p
```

# Fitting MFPCA on healthy dataset

We fit MFPCA on healthy dataset. This requires first putting data wide format.

```{r}
healthy_wide_dat <- healthy_data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Subject, `Gait cycle [%]`, Stride, Angle) %>% 
  mutate(Subject_Stride = interaction(Subject, Stride, sep = "_"))  

healthy_wide_dat <- healthy_wide_dat %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=Subject_Stride, 
              names_from=`Gait cycle [%]`, 
              values_from=Angle)

healthy_wide_dat <- healthy_wide_dat %>% separate(
  Subject_Stride,
  into = c("Subject", "Stride"),
  sep = "_",
  convert = TRUE
)
```

We fit MFPCA with the mfpca.face() function in the refund package. We fit 10 principal components.

```{r}
k=10
increments=1:100

healthy_wide_dat <- healthy_wide_dat[complete.cases(healthy_wide_dat),]

#two-level mfpca 
res_healthy_2way <- mfpca.face(Y = as.matrix(healthy_wide_dat[,-c(1:2)]), 
                               id=healthy_wide_dat$Subject,
                               npc = c(k,k))

res_healthy_2way_results <- data.frame(Gait=increments,
                                       e1.FPC1=res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level1[,1], 
                                       e1.FPC2=res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level1[,2], 
                                       e1.FPC3=res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level1[,3],
                                       e2.FPC1=res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level2[,1], 
                                       e2.FPC2=res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level2[,2], 
                                       e2.FPC3=res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level2[,3])

fpca_results_healthy <- res_healthy_2way_results %>% pivot_longer(cols=-c(Gait), names_to="e", values_to="Eigenfunction")
fpca_results_healthy$Level <- substr(fpca_results_healthy$e, 2, 2)
fpca_results_healthy$Level <- ifelse(fpca_results_healthy$Level==1, "Between-subject", "Within-subject")
fpca_results_healthy$FPC <- substr(fpca_results_healthy$e, 4, 7)

example_dat <- data.frame(Gait=increments, 
                          mean= res_healthy_2way$mu,
                          exp1 = res_healthy_2way$mu + 7*res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level1[,1], 
                          exp2 = res_healthy_2way$mu + 7*res_healthy_2way$efunctions$level1[,2])




plot_mean <- ggplot(data=example_dat, aes(x=Gait, y=mean)) +geom_line(linewidth=1.1)+ 
  geom_line(aes(x=Gait, y=exp1), linetype="longdash", col="#3B528B", linewidth=1.1 )+
  geom_line(aes(x=Gait, y=exp2),  linetype="dotdash", col="darkorange", linewidth=1.1)+
  
  theme_bw()  + ylab("Angle") + ggtitle("(A) Mean Function + Eigenfunctions")

# eigenvalues from mfpca.face
evals1 <- res_healthy_2way$evalues$level1   # between-subject
evals2 <- res_healthy_2way$evalues$level2    # within-subject

# proportion of variance explained
pve1 <- paste0(round(evals1 /sum(evals1)*100, 2), "%") 
pve2 <- paste0(round(evals2 / sum(evals2)*100, 2), "%")

var_exp_1 <- data.frame(FPC= paste0("FPC", 1:3), Level="Between-subject", value=pve1[1:3])
var_exp_2 <- data.frame(FPC= paste0("FPC",1:3), Level="Within-subject", value=pve2[1:3])

sum(evals1[1:3])/sum(evals1)
#88.8% of variance explained by the first three eigenfunctions

var_exp <- rbind(var_exp_1, var_exp_2)

plot_efunction <- ggplot(fpca_results_healthy, aes(x=Gait, y=Eigenfunction)) + geom_line() +  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), # 0 makes text horizontal
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = var_exp %>% filter(FPC %in% c("FPC1", "FPC2", "FPC3", "FPC4")),
    aes(x = 89, y = 2, label = value),     
    inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  facet_grid(FPC~Level) + ggtitle("(B) Eigenfunctions")


plot_scores <- ggplot(data = data.frame(score1=res_healthy_2way$scores$level1[,1], 
                                        score2=res_healthy_2way$scores$level1[,2]), 
                      aes(x=score1, y=score2)) + theme_bw()+geom_point()+ 
  xlab("Subject-level FPC1 score") + ylab("Subject-level FPC2 score") + 
  ggtitle("(C) Subject-level scores")


healthy_fpca <- ggarrange(ggarrange(plot_mean, plot_scores, ncol=1),
                          plot_efunction, widths=c(0.4, 0.6), ncol=2 )

healthy_fpca
```

# MFPCA projection scores on PD dataset

We first prepare the PD dataset by arranging it in wide format. We also obtain the mean peak of the swing phase as a scalar metric which may be of interest.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
wide_dat <- PD_data %>%     
dplyr::select(Subject, Medication, `Gait cycle [%]`, Stride, value) %>%   mutate(Subject_Stride = interaction(Subject, Stride, Medication, sep = "_"))     

wide_dat <- wide_dat %>%      
  pivot_wider(id_cols=Subject_Stride,                
              names_from=`Gait cycle [%]`,               
              values_from=value)    

wide_dat <- wide_dat %>% 
  separate(Subject_Stride,   
           into = c("Subject", "Stride", "Medication"),   
           sep = "_",   convert = TRUE )   

#separate data into on and off medication 
off_dat <- wide_dat %>% filter(Medication=="off")
on_dat <- wide_dat %>% filter(Medication=="on")


#Obtain peak of swing/stance phases
peak_data <- PD_data %>% 
  group_by(Subject, Medication, Stride) %>% 
  summarise(stance_peak=max(value[`Gait cycle [%]` < 50]),
            swing_peak=max(value[`Gait cycle [%]` > 50]))

#Obtain the mean of the peaks across individuals
peak_data <- peak_data %>% 
  group_by(Subject, Medication) %>% 
  summarise(mean_stance_peak=mean(stance_peak), 
            mean_swing_peak=mean(swing_peak))

```

We now use the pre-prepared functions to obtain projection scores of PD individuals when they are off medication.

```{r}
#project PD data onto two level mfpca healthy
predicted_scores_off = predict_mfpca_scores_wide(
  res_healthy_2way, 
  off_dat[,-c(1:3, 104)], 
  off_dat$Subject, 
  res_healthy_2way$sigma2)

predicted_scores_off = predicted_scores_off %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, L1_PC1, L1_PC2, L1_PC3) %>% 
  distinct()

```

We regress the MFPCA projection scores against the clinical outcomes (MDS-UPDRS Part II and Part III). We compare these with regression of the mean peak of the swing phase against the clinical outcomes.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#Get gold standard scores 
diagnosis_wide <- data.frame(Subject=PDGinfo$ID, 
                             UPDRS_II_OFF= PDGinfo$`OFF - UPDRS-II`, 
                             UPDRS_III_OFF= PDGinfo$`OFF - UPDRS-III`,                             UPDRS_II_ON=PDGinfo$`ON - UPDRS-II`,
                             UPDRS_III_ON=PDGinfo$`ON - UPDRS-III`)%>%filter(!(Subject %in% c("SUB04", "SUB23", "SUB25", "SUB26")))

#merge gold standard scores and projected scores 
pd_dat <- data.frame(FPC1=predicted_scores_off$L1_PC1, 
                            FPC2=predicted_scores_off$L1_PC2,
                            FPC3=predicted_scores_off$L1_PC3,
                            UPDRS_II=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_II_OFF), 
                            UPDRS_III=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_III_OFF), 
                            mean_stance_peak=peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="off", "mean_stance_peak"], 
                            mean_swing_peak=peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="off", "mean_swing_peak"])

#Obtain correlations
FPC1_II <- cor.test(pd_dat$FPC1, pd_dat$UPDRS_II)
FPC2_II <- cor.test(pd_dat$FPC2, pd_dat$UPDRS_II)
FPC3_II <- cor.test(pd_dat$FPC3, pd_dat$UPDRS_II)
stance_II <- cor.test(pd_dat$mean_stance_peak, pd_dat$UPDRS_II)
swing_II <- cor.test(pd_dat$mean_swing_peak, pd_dat$UPDRS_II)

FPC1_III <- cor.test(pd_dat$FPC1, pd_dat$UPDRS_III)
FPC2_III <- cor.test(pd_dat$FPC2, pd_dat$UPDRS_III)
FPC3_III <- cor.test(pd_dat$FPC3, pd_dat$UPDRS_III)
stance_III <- cor.test(pd_dat$mean_stance_peak, pd_dat$UPDRS_III)
swing_III <- cor.test(pd_dat$mean_swing_peak, pd_dat$UPDRS_III)

```

# MFPCA projection scores - on/off medication

We now obtain MFPCA projection scores for the "on medication" state on PD patients.

```{r}

predicted_scores_on = predict_mfpca_scores_wide(
  res_healthy_2way, 
  on_dat[,-c(1:3, 104)], 
  on_dat$Subject, 
  res_healthy_2way$sigma2)

predicted_scores_on = predicted_scores_on %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, L1_PC1, L1_PC2, L1_PC3) %>% 
  distinct()
```

We compute changes comparing the "on medication" scores to the "off medication" scores. We also do this for the clinical MDS-UPDRS scores Part II and Part III, and the mean peak.

```{r}
change_scores = data.frame(change_FPC1=predicted_scores_on$L1_PC1-predicted_scores_off$L1_PC1, 
                           change_FPC2=predicted_scores_on$L1_PC2-predicted_scores_off$L1_PC2, 
                           change_FPC3=predicted_scores_on$L1_PC3-predicted_scores_off$L1_PC3, 
                     UPDRS_II=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_II_ON)-as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_II_OFF), 
                     UPDRS_III=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_III_ON)-as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_III_OFF), 
                     change_stance_peak = peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="on", "mean_stance_peak"]-  peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="off", "mean_stance_peak"],
                     change_swing_peak = peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="on", "mean_swing_peak"]-  peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="off", "mean_swing_peak"])
```

We now evaluate correlations in changes in MFPCA projection scores against changes in the clinical outcomes.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

FPC1_II_cor <- cor.test(change_scores$change_FPC1, change_scores$UPDRS_II)
FPC2_II_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$change_FPC2, change_scores$UPDRS_II)
FPC3_II_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$change_FPC3, change_scores$UPDRS_II)
stance_II_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$mean_stance_peak, change_scores$UPDRS_II)
swing_II_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$mean_swing_peak, change_scores$UPDRS_II)


FPC1_III_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$change_FPC1, change_scores$UPDRS_III)
FPC2_III_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$change_FPC2, change_scores$UPDRS_III)
FPC3_III_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$change_FPC3, change_scores$UPDRS_III)
stance_III_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$mean_stance_peak, change_scores$UPDRS_III)
swing_III_cor <-cor.test(change_scores$mean_swing_peak, change_scores$UPDRS_III)

wilcox.test(change_scores$change_FPC1)
wilcox.test(change_scores$change_FPC2)
wilcox.test(change_scores$change_FPC3)
wilcox.test(change_scores$mean_stance_peak)
wilcox.test(change_scores$mean_swing_peak)

```

# Assessing sample size calculations

We compute the empirical power of a paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test (with $\alpha = 0.05$) to detect a non-zero change in each score (clinical outcomes, MFPCA scores, mean of swing/stance peak) as sample size increases. Power is estimated based on 1000 bootstrap resamples drawn with replacement from the PD dataset.

```{r}
#| eval: false

all_scores = data.frame(FPC1_on=predicted_scores_on$L1_PC1,
                        FPC1_off=predicted_scores_off$L1_PC1, 
                        FPC2_on=predicted_scores_on$L1_PC2, 
                        FPC2_off = predicted_scores_off$L1_PC2, 
                        FPC3_on=predicted_scores_on$L1_PC3, 
                        FPC3_off = predicted_scores_off$L1_PC3, 
                        UPDRS_II_on=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_II_ON),
                        UPDRS_II_off=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_II_OFF), 
                        UPDRS_III_on=as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_III_ON), 
                        UPDRS_III_off= as.numeric(diagnosis_wide$UPDRS_III_OFF), 
                        mean_swing_peak_on = peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="on", "mean_swing_peak"]$mean_swing_peak, 
                        mean_swing_peak_off = peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="off", "mean_swing_peak"]$mean_swing_peak, 
                        mean_stance_peak_on = peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="on", "mean_stance_peak"]$mean_stance_peak, 
                        mean_stance_peak_off = peak_data[peak_data$Medication=="off", "mean_stance_peak"]$mean_stance_peak)


library(coin)

set.seed(112026)

all_results <- c()

for (i in 1:1000){
  for (sample_size in c(8:22)){
    ids <- sample(1:22, sample_size, replace=TRUE)
    
    subset<-all_scores[ids,]
    
    FPC1 = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(FPC1_on ~ FPC1_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    FPC2 = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(FPC2_on ~ FPC2_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    FPC3 = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(FPC3_on ~ FPC3_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    UPDRS_II = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(UPDRS_II_on ~ UPDRS_II_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    UPDRS_III  = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(UPDRS_III_on ~ UPDRS_III_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    mean_swing_peak = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(mean_swing_peak_on ~ mean_swing_peak_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    mean_stance_peak = pvalue(wilcoxsign_test(mean_stance_peak_on ~ mean_stance_peak_off, data=subset, distribution = "exact")) <0.05
    
    
    result <- cbind(sim=i, sample_size=sample_size, FPC1=FPC1, FPC2=FPC2, FPC3=FPC3, 
                    UPDRS_II=UPDRS_II, UPDRS_III=UPDRS_III, mean_stance_peak=mean_stance_peak, 
                    mean_swing_peak=mean_swing_peak )
    all_results <- rbind(all_results, result)
  }
}

#plot results 

B=1000
sample_size_power <- all_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(FPC1, FPC2, FPC3, UPDRS_II, UPDRS_III, mean_stance_peak, mean_swing_peak),
    names_to = "Outcome",
    values_to = "significant"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome = case_match(
      Outcome,
      "FPC1"      ~ "MFPCA Score 1",
      "FPC2"      ~ "MFPCA Score 2",
      "FPC3"      ~ "MFPCA Score 3",
      "UPDRS_II"  ~ "MDS UPDRS II",
      "UPDRS_III" ~ "MDS UPDRS III",
      "mean_stance_peak" ~ "Mean Stance Peak",
      "mean_swing_peak" ~ "Mean Swing Peak",
      .default    = Outcome
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_size, Outcome) %>%
  summarise(
    B     = sum(!is.na(significant)),
    power = mean(significant, na.rm = TRUE),
    mcse  = sd(significant, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(B),
    ymin  = pmax(0, power - 1.96 * mcse),
    ymax  = pmin(1, power + 1.96 * mcse),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

power_plot <- ggplot(sample_size_power, aes(x = sample_size, y = power, color = Outcome, fill = Outcome)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x = "Sample Size", y = "Power")

power_plot

```
